title: Grandpa's Memory Box
subtitle: 考点：回忆与情感 / grandson, keep in mind, recall
passage: Jack's grandfather is seventy-eight. Sometimes he forgets where he put his glasses, but he can recall events from fifty years ago clearly. Last Sunday, Jack sat with him in the garden, and Grandpa took out an old wooden box. Inside were a few photos, a ticket to an opera and a small notebook.

'This photo was taken at our first picnic,' Grandpa said. 'It rained, and we ran under a big tree.' He laughed. Jack wrote down the story in a notebook. 'Keep in mind that old stories are like treasure,' Grandpa told him. 'If nobody remembers them, they disappear.' Jack promised to record more of Grandpa's stories on his phone, so the whole family can listen to them in the future.
